turns.text: Chris Gardner.
Chris Gardner. How are you? Good morning.
turns.zh: 克里斯·加德纳。你好吗？早上好。

turns.text: Chris Gardner.
Chris Gardner, good to see you again.
turns.zh: 克里斯·加德纳，很高兴又见到你。

turns.text: Chris Gardner. Pleasure.
I've been sitting out there for the last half hour
turns.zh: 我在外面坐了半个小时了

turns.text: trying to come up with a story that would explain my being here
turns.zh: 想编个故事解释我为什么在这儿

turns.text: dressed like this.
And I wanted to come up with a story that would demonstrate qualities
turns.zh: 我想编个故事来展现一些品质

turns.text: that I'm sure you all admire here, like earnestness or diligence
turns.zh: 我相信在座各位都欣赏的品质，比如认真或者勤勉

turns.text: and team playing to something.
And I couldn't think of anything.
So the truth is, I was arrested
turns.zh: 所以事实是，我被逮捕了

turns.text: for failure to pay parking tickets. - Parking tickets?
turns.zh: 因为没交停车罚单。——停车罚单？

turns.text: - And I ran all the way here from the Polk station,
turns.zh: ——我从波尔克警局一路跑过来的，

turns.text: the police station.
- What were you doing before you were arrested?
I was painting my apartment.
Is it dry now? I hope so.
Jay says you're pretty determined.
He's been waiting outside the front of the building
with some 40-pound gizmo for over a month.
turns.zh: 拿着个四十磅重的东西，等了一个多月。

turns.text: He said you're smart.
I like to think so.
You want to learn this business? Yes,. And you want to learn this business.
turns.zh: 你想学这行吗？想。你想学这行。

turns.text: Yes, sir. I want to learn this business.
Have you already started learning on your own?
turns.zh: 你已经自己开始学了吗？

turns.text: Absolutely. Jay. Yes, sir.
How many times have you seen Chris?
You know, I don't know.
One too many, apparently.
Has he ever dressed like this? No. No.
turns.zh: 他以前穿成这样过吗？没有。没有。

turns.text: Jacket and tie.
First in your class? In school? High school? Yes, sir.
turns.zh: 你是班上第一名？在学校？高中？是的，先生。

turns.text: How many in the class?
12. It was a small town.
I'll say.
But I was also first in my radar class in the Navy,
turns.zh: 但我在海军雷达班也是第一名，

turns.text: and that was a class of 20.
Can I say something?
I'm the type of person, if you ask me a question
turns.zh: 我是那种人，如果你问我一个问题

turns.text: and I don't know the answer,
I'm gonna tell you that I don't know.
But I bet you what, I know how to find the answer
turns.zh: 但你猜怎么着，我知道怎么找到答案

turns.text: and I will find the answer.
Is that fair enough?
Chris, what would you say if a guy walked in for an interview
turns.zh: 克里斯，如果有个家伙来面试

turns.text: without a shirt on? And I hired him. What would you say?
turns.zh: 没穿上衣？而我雇了他。你会怎么说？

turns.text: He must have had on some really nice pants.
turns.zh: 他一定穿了条非常不错的裤子。

turns.text: Chris, I don't know how you did it dressed as a garbage man,
turns.zh: 克里斯，我不知道你穿着像垃圾工一样是怎么做到的，

turns.text: but you really pulled it off in there. Thank you very much, Mr. Twistle.
turns.zh: 但你在里面真的撑住了。非常感谢你，特威斯尔先生。

turns.text: Hey, now you can call me Jay.
turns.zh: 嘿，现在你可以叫我杰伊了。

turns.text: All right, we'll talk to you soon. Thanks.
turns.zh: 好的，我们很快再联系你。谢谢。

turns.text: I'll let you know, Jay.
You'll let me know, Jay. What do you mean?
turns.zh: 你会通知我，杰伊。你什么意思？

turns.text: Yeah, I'll give you a call tomorrow sometime and-- Wait, what? What are you talking--
turns.zh: 是的，我明天找个时间给你打电话，然后——等等，什么？你在说什么——

turns.text: You hounded me for this. You stood here.
turns.zh: 你缠着我要这个机会。你站在这儿。

turns.text: Listen, there's no salary. No. I was not aware of that. My circumstances have changed some and I need to. No. I was not aware of that.
turns.zh: 听着，没有薪水。不。我不知道这事。我的情况有些变化，我需要。不。我不知道这事。

turns.text: My circumstances have changed some,
and I need to be certain that I'll be-- Okay. Okay.
turns.zh: 我需要确定我会——好的。好的。

turns.text: Tonight, I swear I will fill your spot, I promise.
turns.zh: 今晚，我发誓我会补上你的位置，我保证。

turns.text: You know what I'll look like if you back out. You know what I'll look like to the partners?
turns.zh: 你知道如果你退出我会成什么样吗。你知道在合伙人眼里我会成什么样吗？

turns.text: Yes, an ass.
Yeah, an ass [Bleep]
All the way.
You are a piece of work. Tonight.
turns.zh: 你真是个难缠的家伙。今晚。
